newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Pertamina confirms Balongan cracker problem.
newsitem.headline: Pertamina confirms Balongan cracker problem.

text.p: Indonesia's state oil company Pertamina on Thursday confirmed its 83,000 barrels-per-day (bpd) Balongan residue cracker had a technical problem and the unit was still under repair.

"The Balongan residue cracker is still being repaired following an unexpected technical problem. We hope to restart the unit later this week," a Pertamina's official, who declined to be identified, told Reuters.
The official also confirmed the residue catalytic cracker had been shut down on February 6 for unscheduled repair work and Pertamina had been due to restart the unit on February 13.
"We have made several attempts but there is still a small problem. We will repair it as soon as possible," he said.
The official gave no further details.
Pertamina shut down the cracker in November for a 60-day scheduled maintenance.
